title: X05 CAPTURE lane: the title screen with a chapter behind it
_comment: CAPTURE lane for X05, which owes exactly one frame. X05's 313 steps are the save/session lifecycle -- sixteen seeds, eleven copies out, load after load -- and the single §G frame it carries is the title screen with populated slots.
_comment_generated: GENERATED by tools/gate_f/derive_capture_lane.py from X05.json. Do not hand-edit: change the source segment or the authored notes in the generator and regenerate, or the capture lane stops being the journey's own path and §H.1's provenance claim stops being true. `--check` fails CI-style if the two have drifted.
_comment_derivation: Kept: every step of X05 up to and including its last capture (index 12 of 312), minus note/defect/probe_cell/save_out and the four pacing asserts. 11 of 313 steps survive. Step ids carry their origin in `_derived_from`.
_comment_seeding: Run this into the SAME run directory as the logic lanes. Its `seed_save` steps resolve `run://` against that directory's saves, so a capture lane run anywhere else has no chapter to load and will stop at its first seed.
_comment_cost: Class A/B and nearly as cheap as S01C: seed the slots, boot the title, shoot. The other 300 steps are lifecycle telemetry that belongs to the logic lane. Note the difference from GF-01-TITLE-01, which S01C takes: that one is the front door with NO saves, this one is the front door with a chapter behind it, and the pair is the evidence that the slot list renders what it holds.

GF-01-TITLE-02.why: the title screen once slots exist. A boot, after a seed -- the only §G frame in the protocol besides GF-01-TITLE-01 that needs no world at all.

steps.expected: a note event opens the segment

steps.title: empty the live save directory
steps.expected: every slot file is gone, so the seeded slot 4 is the only thing the title's Load list can offer and the auto-focus cannot land on an autosave

steps.title: seed slot 4 from S02-exit
steps.expected: the journey's S02-exit slot file is back in user://, so the title's Load Game finds it

steps.title: boot the real title screen
steps.expected: the real title comes up with Start New Game focused

steps.title: move focus to Load Game
steps.expected: d-pad down moves focus from Start New Game to Load Game

steps.title: open the load slot list
steps.expected: Load Game opens the slot list and auto-focuses the first non-empty slot -- the seeded slot 4

steps.title: load the seeded slot
steps.expected: the slot loads and the title transitions into the Meadows: driven with synthetic input, this is itself save/load coverage (protocol B)

steps.title: let the loaded world stand up
steps.expected: a cold Meadows stand-up costs about 90 s of CPU on this container, and every assertion after this reads a live Player

steps.title: the world owns input
steps.expected: input_context is 'world': the study starts from a real player state rather than a granted one

steps.title: restoration: the world owns input (S02-exit entry)
steps.expected: input_context is 'world' with no stuck modal. This event carries the whole restoration record: `pos`, `party`, `player` (hp/stamina/satiety), `flags`, `clock_hour`, `inventory` and `objective`. E.6.13's restoration checklist: position, party, flags, satiety, time of day, placed buildings, tracked objective.
